request.amount_ada: none requested; proposed net change limit is 500,000,000 ada
request.deadline: Period begins at the start of Epoch 613 on February 13, 2026 and ends at the close of Epoch 713 on or about July 3, 2027.
deliverables: Set or signal agreement to a 500,000,000 ada cap on total Treasury withdrawals debited during Epochs 613-713
Supersede any prior Net Change Limit for the same period
Count all Treasury withdrawals already debited during the period toward the limit
Clarify that the action has no direct on-chain effect and does not authorize any Treasury withdrawal
request.what: Info action to record DRep agreement to a new Net Change Limit for Cardano Treasury withdrawals during Epochs 613-713.

claims.claim: The proposal sets a new Net Change Limit of 500,000,000 ada, equal to 500,000,000,000,000 lovelace, for Epochs 613-713.
The proposed limit caps only lovelace removed from the Cardano Treasury through enacted Treasury Withdrawals recorded on the Cardano ledger during the period.
Treasury inflows, including reserve and protocol allocations, transaction-fee allocations, refunds, and returned Treasury-funded amounts, do not count toward or increase the proposed limit.
The proposal states that all Treasury Withdrawals already debited during Epochs 613-713 count toward the 500,000,000 ada cumulative limit.
The proposal states that this Info action has no direct on-chain effect and does not authorize any Treasury Withdrawal.
The proposer says the existing 350,000,000 ada Net Change Limit has been a useful fiscal guardrail but that practical room under it is becoming constrained.
The proposer says increasing the limit to 500,000,000 ada preserves DReps' ability to consider credible Treasury Withdrawals on their merits while keeping a fixed guardrail and simple accounting.
The proposal claims it is drafted to comply with the enacted Cardano Constitution version 2.4 and Appendix I Guardrails, and provides an IPFS reference to that Constitution.
The proposal claims nothing in the Constitution limits DReps to a single Net Change Limit or prevents a newly agreed Net Change Limit from applying to the same period.

summary: The document is an Info action proposing a higher Cardano Treasury Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713, with detailed accounting rules and an asserted constitutional basis, but limited evidence for the need to increase the prior 350,000,000 ada limit.
